customManagers.description: Version ARGs in the image Dockerfiles, each annotated with a `# renovate:` line directly above it — a pin without one is invisible. The glob covers every image/<name>/Dockerfile: it was `image/Dockerfile` until the runner and nix-worker images split (INF-964 found it), and a literal path silently stops matching the day a file moves. hack/renovate-covers-dockerfiles.sh is the guard.
go install pins inside RUN lines (go-cache-plugin). Same glob, same reason.
